packageRules.description: The service gets its fabric8 jars from the Quarkus BOM, so a separate fabric8 bump mixes versions at runtime (NoClassDefFoundError). The Quarkus modules take the Quarkus-managed fabric8 version; kubernetes-client.version only serves the operator modules and must equal the version the Quarkus BOM manages.
Sample project shipped for the demo, not a dependency of this repo.
Terraform providers use unbounded >= constraints; only surface a PR when the floor genuinely moves.
